current.text: Simons is new in Philadelphia. He is expected to be the sixth man and a backup, not a starter.
Philadelphia's projected starters are Maxey, Edgecombe, Brown, LeBron and Embiid. That leaves little usage for a bench guard.
He would need all the starters to go down to matter in fantasy. If one starter goes down, Dean Wade probably takes the spot instead of him.
Last season he finished 70 percent of his shots at the rim (88th percentile), well above his earlier level.
His shooting numbers should come down this season, both because of that rim finishing jump and his backup role.
Yahoo lists him as questionable with a hamstring injury.
Philadelphia has only 13 back-to-backs. With the March 28 end, it plays 3, 4 and 4 games in our playoff weeks.

durable.text: He gives little in the peripheral categories, so he needs heavy minutes and usage to have fantasy value.
He is one of the worst defenders and rebounders in the NBA.
Nick Nurse plays his starters, and his guards most of all, very heavy minutes. That limits bench minutes.

note: Yahoo and ESPN both value him at 0 USD and rank him 186 and 222, so he is outside the 144 players we draft. Do not pay anything near the 7 USD he cost in our league last season. As a bench guard he projects about 14 points and 2.5 threes with strong FT%, but he gives little FG%, rebounds, steals or blocks, and Dean Wade is the more likely fill-in when a starter misses time. Leave him on waivers and check his hamstring and his minutes only if several Philadelphia starters are out at once.
